subject.title: [Bug]: All channels enter broken state after 2026.6.11 update — one message per session then permanent silence

question: Should maintainers treat the current reply-session and replay-storm fixes as enough to close this v2026.6.11 all-channel incident, or keep it open until webchat plus WhatsApp stable/beta proof covers the reported one-exchange silence and duplicate replies?
rationale: The evidence shows adjacent source and beta-package fixes, but the reported multi-channel production state has no deterministic current-main live reproduction and no stable release proof after v2026.6.11.

options.title: Keep as incident tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open until live webchat plus WhatsApp proof or a stable release validation demonstrates the full reported failure is fixed.

options.title: Split under narrower trackers
options.body: Move the reply-init, channel retry, and replay-storm slices to their specific open issues or PRs and close only after each has a canonical owner and proof target.

options.title: Close after beta proof
options.body: Close based on beta/source fixes if maintainers decide the remaining stable-package and multi-channel proof gap is acceptable.

recommendation.title: Keep as incident tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until live webchat plus WhatsApp proof or a stable release validation demonstrates the full reported failure is fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is mostly release/proof sufficiency for stable versus beta users, and this person provided the related beta-package verification.
